objective: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

description: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.
The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
progress: I hope you find the pages soon, <name>! I really need to get back to work!
completion: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, <name>!
